title: Blade's Bedlam
logline: In a neon mega-city, a battle-hardened mercenary finds himself in the crosshairs of a deadly romance as four beautiful armorer-mercs fight for his affection and survival.
premise: Our protagonist is a hardened mercenary who uses his heavily customized hardsuit to protect the slums. His team, consisting of four alluring women, are more than just armorers; they're also his love interests. As they compete for him with high-tech upgrades and seductive 'suit fittings', they must face off against deadly bio-mechs in a gore-filled fight for survival.
hook: When love meets metal, who will come out on top?
